items.label: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo and Hengrui Pharma enter exclusive license agreement (09-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Licensor Hengrui Pharma: Novo Nordisk entered a license agreement

set.signal: Licensor Hengrui Pharma: Novo Nordisk entered a license agreement with Hengrui Pharma (600276.SH; 01276.HK) for HRS-1596, a phase 1-ready GLP-1 receptor and GIP receptor dual agonist with potential for once-weekly oral dosing. Novo obtains exclusive rights to develop, manufacture and commercialise HRS-1596 globally, excluding mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. The agreement is subject to U.S. Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance and other customary closing conditions and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. CSO Martin Holst Lange: 'we are excited to add HRS-1596 to our growing pipeline and to explore its potential to raise the bar for convenience in the field.'
set.figure: exclusive global rights excluding mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan; expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026

items.reason: Deal-price terms (up to $2.6B total value, $300M upfront, royalties) are excluded by SKILL §2 (never the price; matches the AstraZeneca-Dizal licence precedent); phase 1 trial authorisation dropped (trial items yield nothing for ai_bio pharma); CSO quote re-quoted verbatim instead of a merged paraphrase.
items.evidence: The potential total value of the agreement is up to 2.6 billion US dollars ... This includes a 300 million dollars upfront payment. / we are excited to add HRS-1596 to our growing pipeline

items.label: Vertex press release: Vertex Completes Acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals (09-01-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Vertex completed its acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals on September 1, 2026

set.signal: Vertex completed its acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals on September 1, 2026, after receiving the necessary regulatory clearances and Crinetics shareholder approval. The acquisition brings PALSONIFY (paltusotine), which Vertex calls the first and only once-daily oral therapy for acromegaly (company claim) and which has been launched in the U.S., approved in the EU and is under review by other global regulatory bodies, and atumelnant, a once-daily oral ACTH receptor antagonist in Phase 3 development for congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) and Phase 2 development for Cushing's syndrome, plus several other pipeline programs. Vertex says the deal establishes rare endocrine diseases as its next pillar of growth, that PALSONIFY and atumelnant have the potential to deliver more than $5 billion in combined annual revenue at peak, and that it is expected to become accretive to non-GAAP operating income in 2029. CEO Reshma Kewalramani said Vertex looks forward to continuing to launch PALSONIFY globally and accelerating the atumelnant program.

items.reason: Removed the earnings-call scheduling sentence (event / webcast schedules are excluded by SKILL §2); all other content verified verbatim against the release.
items.evidence: Vertex will provide details on the accounting and financial impacts of the transaction on its third quarter earnings call, scheduled for November 2, 2026.
